# Test fixtures

Short text excerpts that reproduce the *layout* of official notices. Numbers in
`ug_1237_result.txt` and `ke_2026-10-26_result.txt` are the independently checked
ground-truth cells quoted in the project handoff (Bank of Uganda auction #1237,
4 Nov 2026; CBK issue dated 26 Oct 2026). Other fixtures are synthetic or minimal
excerpts used only to exercise parser edge cases (DOCX run-together text, two-digit
years, Ghana joined ordinal dates, malformed numbers). No source PDFs are bundled.
